name: National AIDS & Health Guidance Helpline 1097
name_hindi: राष्ट्रीय एड्स एवं स्वास्थ्य मार्गदर्शन हेल्पलाइन 1097
department: MP State AIDS Control Society (MPSACS), Government of Madhya Pradesh
beneficiary: General public and patients seeking health advice on HIV/AIDS and STI prevention
benefits: Anonymous counseling, guidance on free testing centers, treatment locations, and awareness.
eligibility: Anyone seeking health guidance or information on HIV/AIDS
application_process: Dial 1097 to speak confidentially with health counselors.
